title: NSPG: Natural language Processing-based Security Property Generator for Hardware Security Assurance
problem: Generating security properties for complex SoCs traditionally requires expert intervention and is limited to a few IPs. This manual approach is time-consuming and non-robust, limiting the efficiency of hardware validation.
motivation: The efficiency of validating complex System-on-Chips depends critically on the quality of security properties provided.
method: The system analyzes hardware documentation using HS-BERT, a language model (software trained to understand text patterns) built specifically for hardware security tasks, to automatically identify security properties—rules about what the hardware should and shouldn't do. The extracted security properties can then be directly converted into assertions (automated checks that verify the hardware design), replacing the manual engineering work that was previously required.
key_novelty: HS-BERT is the first language model designed specifically for hardware security, automatically identifying security properties from hardware documentation.
contributions: Novel NLP-based automated security property generator (NSPG) for hardware verification
HS-BERT: first hardware security-specific language model trained on SoC documentation
Achieves 88% accuracy for property classification, outperforming ChatGPT
Identified 8 security vulnerabilities in OpenTitan SoC during Hack@DAC 2022 evaluation
primary_theme: NLP-based automated hardware security property generation
